milestones.title: Sit NEET-PG
milestones.detail: NEET-PG is the only entrance exam for MD, MS and PG Diploma seats; no state or institute exam replaces it. To sit it you need your MBBS, NMC or State Medical Council registration, and your internship complete by the cut-off date (31 July for NEET-PG 2025).
